name: Proving Grounds - a glass cannon, absorbed as plain content
notes: Mario's fifth requested design, and the cleanest 'absorbed with nothing new' case on this bench: unit.bench.sniper is an ordinary AttackDef (range 9, damage 22, cooldown 40) tuned to one extreme, nothing else. Two troopers close from across the field; the sniper gets at most one or two shots off, at most, before melee arrives and its own 14 hp gives out in a single hit - a long reach that has to earn its keep.
